rachats.citation: Ahold Delhaize announced the acquisition of Romanian retailer Profi for approximately €1.3 billion.
The company further expanded in the United States with the acquisition of a majority stake in FreshDirect, an online grocer.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
